messages:
deploy-bot: Preflight snapshot — change window starts in ~10m. Observability summary attached. p95=120ms (baseline 110ms), errors=0.04% (SLO 0.1%), embed-route 5xx spike: 3/min. Rolling plan: 10% -> 50% -> 100% (5m intervals). Reply :thumbsup: to proceed. Link: https://dash.redwood.ai/preflight/1709504321
maya: Seen. Quick Q — dashboards show tiny p95 bump in cache-priming shards, can we add +5m hold at 10% if it doesn't settle? :eyes:
sam: +1 to extra hold. Also noticed embed route 5xx went 3->6/min in last 2m, not huge but worth watching. Query I ran: `sum(increase(http_requests_total{code=~\"5..\",route=\"embed\"}[2m]))`
eli: I'm on observability watches. If 5xx > 10/min or p95 > 150ms we should auto-pause and tag @backend-oncall. I'll open traces and sampled spans now. :mag:
backend-oncall: Oncall here. Standby. If it spikes we'll rollback to v2026.03.15. Confirming canary fallback is enabled to model-lite-v1, right?
maya: Yes fallback enabled. Routing policy has model-lite-v1 as secondary. Also toggling KV cache prefill for canary: `kc.prefill=true` for this rollout.
deploy-bot: Traffic shifted to 10% at 1709504350. Monitoring SLOs for next 5m. Dash: https://dash.redwood.ai/rollouts/1709504350 :rocket:
obs-bot: ALERT @channel — embed-route 5xx rate breached soft threshold at 1709504369 (8/min). Action: HOLD rollout at current traffic. :warning:
eli: Saw the alert. Initial traces show a burst of cache misses hitting embed upstream. Applying sticky prefill to canary nodes now to reduce miss amplification.
backend-oncall: If error rate doesn't drop below 5/min in 3m, recommend rollback. I'll stage v2026.03.14 for rapid revert.
sam: Sounds good. Proposal: hold for 4m and re-evaluate — resume if p95 < 130ms and 5xx < 5/min. Otherwise rollback.
maya: Ack. Noting this in release notes: "paused at 10% due to transient embed 5xx; mitigated via KV cache prefill; will resume pending stability check." I'll update after the 4m watch. :pencil2:
